patch_description: Add a pairwise-swap local search after single-model relocations. Relocation-only search can get stuck when the bottleneck GPU cannot give away a model because no target has enough free memory, even though exchanging it with a smaller model on another GPU is feasible. This search evaluates feasible swaps involving a current bottleneck GPU and applies the swap that strictly lowers the global maximum KVPR, repeating until no improving exchange remains.
